photo.title: View of houses and totem poles at Masset village (formerly Massett) on Graham Island, Haida Gwaii (formerly the Queen Charlotte Islands), in British Columbia, Canada.  Second from right is the totem pole, or frontal post, outside Star House (k'aayhlt'aa), which was built around 1879 and belonged to Chief Anetlas.  The Haida totem pole came to the Pitt Rivers Museum in 1901, donated by Professor E. B. Tylor.
